Candidate-cluster generation\n//    for different seeds is independent, so one thread block is assigned per\n//    seed. Inside a block, the threads cooperatively evaluate all candidate\n//    points of each greedy growth step and perform a block-wide argmin with\n//    the same tie-breaking (lowest point index) as the sequential code.\n//  * Only points within `threshold` of the seed can ever join the seed's\n//    cluster (the seed itself is a member), so each block first compacts the\n//    unclustered points inside that radius into a working list (shared memory\n//    when it fits, global scratch otherwise).\n//  * The maximum distance of a candidate to the growing cluster is maintained\n//    incrementally (max is order independent), so every growth step costs\n//    O(candidates) instead of O(candidates * members).\n//  * The result of a seed only depends on the set of unclustered points within\n//    `threshold` of it. After a cluster is committed, only seeds whose\n//    neighbourhood lost a point are re-evaluated (\"dirty\" seeds); all other\n//    cardinalities are reused unchanged.\n//  * Floating point: distances use fma(dx, dx, dy*dy) followed by an IEEE\n//    sqrt, which is exactly what the optimized host build computes.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                         \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            exit(1);                                                            \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points (host, used for validation)\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / 32;\n// Bytes of working-list storage per candidate: x, y, running max dist^2, index\nconstexpr int BYTES_PER_CANDIDATE = 3 * sizeof(double) + sizeof(int);\n// Candidates kept in shared memory; larger neighbourhoods use global scratch\nconstexpr int SMEM_CANDIDATES = 2560;\nconstexpr size_t SMEM_LIST_BYTES = static_cast<size_t>(SMEM_CANDIDATES) * BYTES_PER_CANDIDATE;\n\n// Squared distance, bit-identical to the host build: fma(dx, dx, dy*dy)\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dist2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {\n    const double dx = __dsub_rn(ax, bx);\n    const double dy = __dsub_rn(ay, by);\n    return __fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy));\n}\n\nstruct Best {\n    double val;   // max distance of the candidate to the cluster\n    int orig;     // original point index (tie breaker: lowest wins)\n    int pos;      // position in the compact working list\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool better(double v, int o, const Best& b) {\n    return (v < b.val) || (v == b.val && o < b.orig);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpReduceBest(Best& b) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double v = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.val, off);\n        const int o = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.orig, off);\n        const int p = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.pos, off);\n        if (better(v, o, b)) { b.val = v; b.orig = o; b.pos = p; }\n    }\n}\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of one seed exactly like the sequential greedy\n// procedure and returns its cardinality (and optionally its members).\n__device__ void growCluster(const int seed,\n                            const double* __restrict__ px,\n                            const double* __restrict__ py,\n                            const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                            const double threshold,\n                            const int N,\n                            double* cx, double* cy, double* cmd, int* cidx,  // working list\n                            int* out_card,\n                            int* out_members)\n{\n    __shared__ int s_count;\n    __shared__ Best s_warp[WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ Best s_sel;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n\n    const double sx = px[seed];\n    const double sy = py[seed];\n    const double thr2 = threshold * threshold;\n\n    if (tid == 0) s_count = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // 1. Compact the unclustered points within `threshold` of the seed.\n    //    (A point with dist(seed, p) >= threshold can never join: the seed is\n    //    a member, so its max distance would be >= threshold.)\n    int seed_pos = -1;\n    for (int i = tid; i < N; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n        if (clustered[i]) continue;\n        const double x = px[i], y = py[i];\n        const double d2 = dist2(x, y, sx, sy);\n        // Cheap conservative reject, then the exact test used by the original\n        if (d2 >= thr2 * 1.0000001) continue;\n        if (!(sqrt(d2) < threshold)) continue;\n        const int pos = atomicAdd(&s_count, 1);\n        cx[pos] = x;\n        cy[pos] = y;\n        cmd[pos] = (i == seed) ? INFINITY : d2;   // seed is a member already\n        cidx[pos] = i;\n        if (i == seed) seed_pos = pos;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    const int M = s_count;\n    (void)seed_pos;\n\n    int members = 1;\n    if (out_members && tid == 0) out_members[0] = seed;\n    double nx = sx, ny = sy;   // most recently added member\n\n    // 2. Greedy growth: repeatedly add the candidate with the smallest maximum\n    //    distance to the current members (ties -> lowest point index).\n    while (members < M) {\n        Best b{INFINITY, INT_MAX, -1};\n        for (int i = tid; i < M; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n            double v = cmd[i];\n            if (v == INFINITY) continue;           // already a member\n            const double d2 = dist2(cx[i], cy[i], nx, ny);\n            v = (v < d2) ? d2 : v;                 // std::max(max_dist, dist)\n            cmd[i] = v;\n            const double d = sqrt(v);              // sqrt(max(a,b)) == max(sqrt(a), sqrt(b))\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int o = cidx[i];\n                if (better(d, o, b)) { b.val = d; b.orig = o; b.pos = i; }\n            }\n        }\n        warpReduceBest(b);\n        if (lane == 0) s_warp[warp] = b;\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            Best r = (lane < WARPS_PER_BLOCK) ? s_warp[lane] : Best{INFINITY, INT_MAX, -1};\n            warpReduceBest(r);\n            if (lane == 0) s_sel = r;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const Best sel = s_sel;\n        if (sel.pos < 0) break;                    // nothing fits any more\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            cmd[sel.pos] = INFINITY;\n            if (out_members) out_members[members] = sel.orig;\n        }\n        nx = cx[sel.pos];\n        ny = cy[sel.pos];\n        ++members;\n        __syncthreads(); Candidate-cluster generation\n//    for different seeds is independent, so one thread block is assigned per\n//    seed. Inside a block, the threads cooperatively evaluate all candidate\n//    points of each greedy growth step and perform a block-wide argmin with\n//    the same tie-breaking (lowest point index) as the sequential code.\n//  * Only points within `threshold` of the seed can ever join the seed's\n//    cluster (the seed itself is a member), so each block first compacts the\n//    unclustered points inside that radius into a working list (shared memory\n//    when it fits, global scratch otherwise).\n//  * The maximum distance of a candidate to the growing cluster is maintained\n//    incrementally (max is order independent), so every growth step costs\n//    O(candidates) instead of O(candidates * members).\n//  * The result of a seed only depends on the set of unclustered points within\n//    `threshold` of it.   // max distance of the candidate to the cluster\n    int orig;     // original point index (tie breaker: lowest wins)\n    int pos;      // position in the compact working list\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool better(double v, int o, const Best& b) {\n    return (v < b.val) || (v == b.val && o < b.orig);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpReduceBest(Best& b) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double v = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.val, off);\n        const int o = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.orig, off);\n        const int p = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, b.pos, off);\n        if (better(v, o, b)) { b.val = v; b.orig = o; b.pos = p; }\n    }\n}\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of one seed exactly like the sequential greedy\n// procedure and returns its cardinality (and optionally its members).\n__device__ void growCluster(const int seed,\n                            const double* __restrict__ px,\n                            const double* __restrict__ py,\n                            const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                            const double threshold,\n                            const int N,\n                            double* cx, double* cy, double* cmd, int* cidx,  // working list\n                            int* out_card,\n                            int* out_members)\n{\n    __shared__ int s_count;\n    __shared__ Best s_warp[WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ Best s_sel;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n\n    const double sx = px[seed];\n    const double sy = py[seed];\n    const double thr2 = threshold * threshold;\n\n    if (tid == 0) s_count = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // 1. Compact the unclustered points within `threshold` of the seed.\n    //    (A point with dist(seed, p) >= threshold can never join: the seed is\n    //    a member, so its max distance would be >= threshold.)\n    int seed_pos = -1;\n    for (int i = tid; i < N; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n        if (clustered[i]) continue;\n        const double x = px[i], y = py[i];\n        const double d2 = dist2(x, y, sx, sy);\n        // Cheap conservative reject, then the exact test used by the original\n        if (d2 >= thr2 * 1.0000001) continue;\n        if (!(sqrt(d2) < threshold)) continue;\n        const int pos = atomicAdd(&s_count, 1);\n        cx[pos] = x;\n        cy[pos] = y;\n        cmd[pos] = (i == seed) ? INFINITY : d2;   // seed is a member already\n        cidx[pos] = i;\n        if (i == seed) seed_pos = pos;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    const int M = s_count;\n    (void)seed_pos;\n\n    int members = 1;\n    if (out_members && tid == 0) out_members[0] = seed;\n    double nx = sx, ny = sy;   // most recently added member\n\n    // 2. Greedy growth: repeatedly add the candidate with the smallest maximum\n    //    distance to the current members (ties -> lowest point index).\n    while (members < M) {\n        Best b{INFINITY, INT_MAX, -1};\n        for (int i = tid; i < M; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n            double v = cmd[i];\n            if (v == INFINITY) continue;           // already a member\n            const double d2 = dist2(cx[i], cy[i], nx, ny);\n            v = (v < d2) ? d2 : v;                 // std::max(max_dist, dist)\n            cmd[i] = v;\n            const double d = sqrt(v);              // sqrt(max(a,b)) == max(sqrt(a), sqrt(b))\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int o = cidx[i];\n                if (better(d, o, b)) { b.val = d; b.orig = o; b.pos = i; }\n            }\n        }\n        warpReduceBest(b);\n        if (lane == 0) s_warp[warp] = b;\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            Best r = (lane < WARPS_PER_BLOCK) ? s_warp[lane] : Best{INFINITY, INT_MAX, -1};\n            warpReduceBest(r);\n            if (lane == 0) s_sel = r;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const Best sel = s_sel;\n        if (sel.pos < 0) break;                    // nothing fits any more\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            cmd[sel.pos] = INFINITY;\n            if (out_members) out_members[members] = sel.orig;\n        }\n        nx = cx[sel.pos];\n        ny = cy[sel.pos];\n        ++members;\n        __syncthreads();                           // cmd/s_sel reuse hazard\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) *out_card = members;\n}\n\n// One block per seed listed in `seeds`.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ncandidateClustersKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                        const int num_seeds,\n                        const double* __restrict__ px,\n                        const double* __restrict__ py,\n                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                        const double threshold,\n                        const int N,\n                        double* __restrict__ gscratch,   // per-block global fallback\n                        int* __restrict__ cardinality,   // indexed by point id\n                        int* __restrict__ members_out)   // only used when num_seeds == 1\n{\n    extern __shared__ unsigned char smem_raw[];\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n\n        // Decide between shared memory and global scratch for the working list.\n        // The upper bound on the list length is the number of unclustered\n        // points, which the host passes implicitly via N; a cheap count of the\n        // neighbourhood is done first so that the common small case stays in\n        // shared memory.\n        __shared__ int s_neigh;\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_neigh = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        {\n            const double sx = px[seed], sy = py[seed];\n            const double lim = threshold * threshold * 1.0000001;\n            int cnt = 0;\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n                if (!clustered[i] && dist2(px[i], py[i], sx, sy) < lim) ++cnt;\n            }\n            cnt = __reduce_add_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt);\n            if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) atomicAdd(&s_neigh, cnt);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int neigh = s_neigh;\n\n        double *cx, *cy, *cmd;\n        int* cidx;\n        if (neigh <= SMEM_CANDIDATES) {\n            cx = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem_raw);\n            cy = cx + SMEM_CANDIDATES;\n            cmd = cy + SMEM_CANDIDATES;\n            cidx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(cmd + SMEM_CANDIDATES);\n        } else {\n            double* base = gscratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * (3 * static_cast<size_t>(N) + (N + 1) / 2);\n            cx = base;\n            cy = cx + N;\n            cmd = cy + N;\n            cidx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(cmd + N);\n        }\n\n        growCluster(seed, px, py, clustered, threshold, N, cx, cy, cmd, cidx,\n                    cardinality + seed, members_out);\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Marks every unclustered seed whose neighbourhood (dist < threshold) contains\n// one of the newly clustered points. Those seeds must be re-evaluated.\n__global__ void markDirtyKernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                                const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                const int* __restrict__ new_members,\n                                const int num_new,\n                                const    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = (i < N) && !clustered[i];\n    const double sx = active ? px[i] : 0.0;\n    const double sy = active ? py[i] : 0.0;\n }\n    if (i < N) dirty[i] = active && d;\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU accelerated, same result as sequential)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const
